def: An optimiser whose update rule is itself trained, usually across many small training runs.
A model adapting to a task from examples in its prompt without any change to its weights.
A self-improving coding agent that picks which agent to expand by the aggregated performance of its descendants instead of its own score.
The gap between an agent's own benchmark score and how good its descendants turn out to be.
A task agent and a meta agent in one editable program, so the procedure that generates improvements can itself be changed.
A self-improving framework in which learned evaluators change alongside the agents they judge.
